data.gender_notes: Mabrura is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abr', meaning to be pure or free from sin. In Islamic tradition, it is a name given to a girl who is innocent, pure, and trustworthy. The name Mabrura carries the meaning “Pure, innocent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mabrura usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mabrura total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

By bestowing this name upon a child, parents are expressing their hope that the child will grow up to be a person of strong character and unwavering commitment to their faith. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking forgiveness from Allah (God) and striving towards leading a life that adheres to the Islamic principles of justice, compassion, and humility.
